title: Leading economies’ borrowing costs hit highest since 2008 crisis

paragraphs.en: Government borrowing costs in several advanced economies hit their highest level since the 2008 financial crisis, or even earlier, on Monday as investors feared the Middle East crisis would keep inflation persistently high.
paragraphs.zh: 周一，由于投资者担心中东危机会使通胀持续处于高位，多个发达经济体的政府借款成本升至2008年金融危机以来——甚至更早以来——的最高水平。

paragraphs.en: Concerns over rising prices and government spending pushed up the cost of debt issued by Paris, Berlin, Washington DC, Tokyo and London as investors fretted that rising prices would push up interest rates.
paragraphs.zh: 对物价上涨和政府支出的担忧，推高了巴黎、柏林、华盛顿、东京和伦敦发行的国债成本，因为投资者担心物价上涨会推高利率。

paragraphs.en: The yield, or interest rate, on 30-year French bonds rose to its highest level since September 2008 at 4.8558%, up one basis point (0.01 percentage point), LSEG data showed.
paragraphs.zh: 伦敦证券交易所集团（LSEG）的数据显示，法国30年期国债收益率升至4.8558%，为2008年9月以来的最高水平，上升1个基点（0.01个百分点）。

paragraphs.en: Related: Interest rate dilemma for central banks as inflation rises but growth slows
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：通胀上升而增长放缓，央行面临利率困境

paragraphs.en: France’s 10-year bond yield hit its highest level since June 2009, up 1bp to 4.0516%. The equivalent German bond rose to its highest yield since 2011 at 3.2138%, up 1.5bps.
paragraphs.zh: 法国10年期国债收益率上升1个基点至4.0516%，为2009年6月以来的最高水平。同期德国10年期国债收益率上升1.5个基点至3.2138%，为2011年以来的最高水平。

paragraphs.en: Fears that central banks would continue to tighten monetary policy, to prevent inflation bursting out of control, pushed up bond yields as traders sought a higher rate of return for holding government debt.
paragraphs.zh: 由于担心各央行将继续收紧货币政策以防止通胀失控，交易员要求持有政府债券获得更高回报，从而推高了债券收益率。

paragraphs.en: The money markets indicate there is almost an 85% chance that the European Central Bank will raise interest rates in September.
paragraphs.zh: 货币市场显示，欧洲央行9月加息的可能性接近85%。

paragraphs.en: The ongoing Middle East crisis pushed oil prices up by 6% last week, and Brent crude rose higher on Monday as the US and Iran struggled to end the conflict and Donald Trump again threatened to bomb Oman if it “gets in the way” of his effort to end the war.
paragraphs.zh: 持续的中东危机上周推动油价上涨6%，周一布伦特原油价格进一步走高，原因是美国与伊朗难以结束冲突，而唐纳德·特朗普再次威胁称，如果阿曼“妨碍”他结束战争的努力，就对其进行轰炸。
